trackInfo.heading: Opening Times
trackInfo.text:
Leisure centre opening hours:

Monday – Friday: 6:00 am – 10:00 pm
Saturday – Sunday: 8:00 am – 6:00 pm
Bank Holidays: 9:00 am – 9:00 pm

The stadium is sometimes closed on weekday daytimes for school sports days. Hours can change for events and bank holidays, so check with the venue before travelling.

trackInfo.heading: Track Details
trackInfo.text:
Length: 400m oval
Lanes: 8
Floodlights: Yes
Field Facilities: Javelin and hammer.
Spectator Seating: Grandstand beside the track.

trackInfo.heading: Parking Details
trackInfo.text: Accessible parking is available. Mile End and Limehouse are the nearest stations.

trackInfo.heading: Address
trackInfo.text: Mile End Park Leisure Centre and Stadium, 190 Burdett Road, London, E3 4HL

trackInfo.heading: Website
trackInfo.text: Visit the Be Well website for track bookings, prices and current opening times.
